questions.q: Can I file ITR-1 if I have long-term capital gains on listed shares?
questions.reference: Yes, only if the gain is under section 112A and total LTCG 112A does not exceed Rs 1.25 lakh; any other capital gain needs ITR-2.

questions.q: How many house properties are allowed in ITR-1 for AY 2026-27?
questions.reference: Up to two house properties.

questions.q: What is the total income limit for ITR-1?
questions.reference: Total income up to Rs 50 lakh.

questions.q: Can an NRI file ITR-1?
questions.reference: No. ITR-1 is for resident and ordinarily resident individuals; NRIs and RNORs file ITR-2 (or ITR-3 with business income).

questions.q: I am a director in a private company and earn only salary. Which ITR?
questions.reference: ITR-2: a director of a company cannot use ITR-1 or ITR-4.

questions.q: Freelance consultant with Rs 38 lakh receipts under section 44ADA: which ITR?
questions.reference: ITR-4, as 44ADA allows receipts up to Rs 50 lakh (Rs 75 lakh if cash receipts are 5% or less).

questions.q: What is the 44ADA receipts limit?
questions.reference: Rs 50 lakh, or Rs 75 lakh if cash receipts do not exceed 5% of total receipts.

questions.q: I trade futures and options and also have a salary. Which ITR do I file?
questions.reference: ITR-3: F&O is business income and is not covered by ITR-4.

questions.q: Which ITR does a partner who gets remuneration from a firm file?
questions.reference: ITR-3, because partner remuneration and interest are business income.

questions.q: I sold crypto this year. Can I still use ITR-1?
questions.reference: No. Income from virtual digital assets needs ITR-2 (or ITR-3 for business) with Schedule VDA.

questions.q: I missed the ITR due date for AY 2026-27. What can I do?
questions.reference: File a belated return under section 139(4) by 31 December 2026 with the section 234F fee and 234A interest; after that only an updated return under 139(8A) (ITR-U) with additional tax.

questions.q: What is the late filing fee under section 234F?
questions.reference: Rs 1,000 if total income is up to Rs 5 lakh, otherwise Rs 5,000.

questions.q: I filed ITR-1 but forgot to report share sale gains. What now?
questions.reference: File a revised return under section 139(5) on ITR-2 before 31 March 2027; later an updated return (ITR-U) with additional tax.

questions.q: How much extra tax is payable on an updated return filed within 12 months?
questions.reference: 25% of the tax and interest payable.

questions.q: Which regime has a Rs 60,000 rebate under section 87A for income up to Rs 12 lakh?
questions.reference: The new regime.

questions.q: Can I claim HRA in the new tax regime?
questions.reference: No. HRA exemption is allowed only in the old regime.

questions.q: Which section of the Income-tax Act 2025 corresponds to the belated return provision 139(4)?
questions.reference: Section 263(4) of the Income-tax Act, 2025.

questions.q: From which tax year does the Income-tax Act 2025 apply?
questions.reference: From 1 April 2026, i.e. tax year 2026-27 onwards; returns for FY 2025-26 are filed under the 1961 Act.

questions.q: Who files ITR-7?
questions.reference: Persons required to file under section 139(4A) to (4D), such as charitable or religious trusts, political parties and certain institutions.

questions.q: What is the penalty for under-reporting income under section 270A?
questions.reference: 50% of the tax on under-reported income, and 200% for misreporting.

questions.q: What is the capital of France?
questions.reference: Out of scope: the assistant should say it cannot answer from the tax documents.
